title: What to expect from Google’s 2026 Pixel hardware launch event
summary: Google is expected to announce four new smartphones: the Pixel 11, the Pixel 11 Pro, the Pixel 11 Pro XL, and the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. Google may also launch something brand new: Pixel Tag , an AirTag-like item tracker.
